verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships its own background automation. Monitors automatically check connected systems, integrations refresh data up to daily, evidence is collected automatically, and access-review reminders follow policy timelines. These are fixed, built-in automations rather than ones the user designs, and the MCP server is assistant-driven and interactive rather than a background agent. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, custom triggers and schedules, autonomous agent or background task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
Monitors and integrations will be refreshing data up to daily or ad-hoc
Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations
Remind you to to start your reviews according to your policy's timelines... Automate the gathering of evidence for audits (when applicable).
High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.
